'''Vansic's Scrap & Trade Market''' was a junk shop in the hidden township of [[Aurilia]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was run by the [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Vansic]]. It was built after the reconstruction of the village, following the [[battle of Aurilia]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:VansicsScrapAndTradeMarket-SWG.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The interior of the shop.]]
Vansic's Scrap & Trade Market appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vansic's Scrap & Trade Market was added to the game along with the revamped city of [[W:c:swg:Aurilia|Aurilia]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" update on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>

Like several other buildings in the city, Vansic's Scrap & Trade Market reused the building model that was first used in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] as a hunting [[Chiss Hunter Settlement|lodge]] for the [[Chiss Poachers]] in the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> Its name was revealed by signs in front of the building.<ref name="SWG:A" />
